modalities.description_zh: 通过化学合成制得的低分子量药物，多可口服，能穿透细胞膜作用于胞内靶点（激酶、GPCR、酶等）。仍是处方量最大的药物类别。
modalities.description_en: Chemically synthesized low-molecular-weight drugs, usually orally available, able to cross cell membranes and hit intracellular targets (kinases, GPCRs, enzymes). Still the largest class by prescription volume.
modalities.notes_zh: BTK/CDK4-6/EGFR 等靶向激酶抑制剂、GLP-1 口服小分子均属此类。
modalities.notes_en: Targeted kinase inhibitors (BTK, CDK4/6, EGFR) and oral GLP-1 agents belong here.

modalities.description_zh: 针对单一抗原表位的工程化抗体，靶向性强、半衰期长，是肿瘤与免疫领域的主力生物药（如 PD-1/PD-L1、HER2、TNF-α 抗体）。
modalities.description_en: Engineered antibodies targeting a single epitope; high specificity and long half-life. The workhorse biologic class in oncology and immunology (PD-1/PD-L1, HER2, TNF-α antibodies).
modalities.notes_zh: Keytruda、Humira、Herceptin 等全球销冠多为单抗。
modalities.notes_en: Many global best-sellers (Keytruda, Humira, Herceptin) are mAbs.

modalities.description_zh: 一个分子同时结合两个不同靶点（如 PD-1×CTLA-4、PD-1×VEGF，或 T 细胞接合器 CD3×肿瘤抗原），可实现单抗难以达到的协同或桥接效应。
modalities.description_en: A single molecule binding two distinct targets (e.g. PD-1×CTLA-4, PD-1×VEGF, or T-cell engagers CD3×tumor-antigen), enabling synergy or bridging that mAbs cannot.
modalities.notes_zh: 中国康方的 cadonilimab、ivonescimab 是该模态的代表性突破。
modalities.notes_en: China's Akeso cadonilimab and ivonescimab are landmark examples.

modalities.description_zh: 单抗经连接子偶联细胞毒载荷，将化疗药精准递送至表达靶抗原的肿瘤细胞，兼顾靶向性与杀伤力。
modalities.description_en: A monoclonal antibody covalently linked via a linker to a cytotoxic payload, delivering chemotherapy selectively to antigen-expressing tumor cells.
modalities.notes_zh: 第一三共/AstraZeneca 的 Enhertu 与中国荣昌的维迪西妥单抗（disitamab vedotin）是热门竞品。
modalities.notes_en: Daiichi Sankyo/AstraZeneca's Enhertu and China's RemeGen disitamab vedotin are leading competitors.

modalities.description_zh: 将两个或多个蛋白功能域融合为单一分子（如受体胞外域与抗体 Fc 融合的 Fc-fusion），常用于诱饵受体或长效化。
modalities.description_en: Two or more protein domains fused into one molecule (e.g. receptor ectodomain fused to an antibody Fc), often used as decoy receptors or for half-life extension.
modalities.notes_zh: Eylea (aflibercept)、Enbrel (etanercept) 为代表。
modalities.notes_en: Eylea (aflibercept) and Enbrel (etanercept) are representative.

modalities.description_zh: 由氨基酸链构成、介于小分子与蛋白之间的药物，常作用于细胞表面受体。GLP-1 类降糖减重药多为多肽。
modalities.description_en: Amino-acid-chain drugs between small molecules and proteins, often acting on cell-surface receptors. Most GLP-1 diabetes/obesity drugs are peptides.
modalities.notes_zh: Ozempic/Wegovy (semaglutide)、Mounjaro (tirzepatide) 为代表。
modalities.notes_en: Ozempic/Wegovy (semaglutide) and Mounjaro (tirzepatide) are representative.

modalities.description_zh: 通过重组 DNA 技术在细胞中表达的治疗性蛋白，如重组胰岛素、凝血因子、酶替代疗法。
modalities.description_en: Therapeutic proteins expressed in cells via recombinant DNA — recombinant insulin, clotting factors, enzyme-replacement therapies.
modalities.notes_zh: CSL 的血浆衍生及重组凝血因子是典型业务。
modalities.notes_en: CSL's plasma-derived and recombinant clotting factors are a classic example.

modalities.description_zh: 递送编码抗原的信使 RNA，由人体细胞自行表达抗原以诱导免疫。COVID-19 大流行中实现产业化。
modalities.description_en: Delivers messenger RNA encoding an antigen, which host cells translate to trigger immunity. Industrialized during the COVID-19 pandemic.
modalities.notes_zh: BioNTech/Pfizer Comirnaty、Moderna Spikevax 为代表。
modalities.notes_en: BioNTech/Pfizer Comirnaty and Moderna Spikevax are representative.

modalities.description_zh: 以纯化的病原体蛋白抗原（常配佐剂）诱导免疫，安全性数据成熟。
modalities.description_en: Uses purified pathogen protein antigens (often with an adjuvant) to elicit immunity; well-established safety profile.
modalities.notes_zh: Novavax Nuvaxovid、智飞/中科院 ZF2001 为代表。
modalities.notes_en: Novavax Nuvaxovid and Zhifei/CAS ZF2001 are representative.

modalities.description_zh: 用改造后的无害病毒（如腺病毒）携带抗原基因递送至人体细胞。
modalities.description_en: Uses a harmless engineered virus (e.g. adenovirus) to carry the antigen gene into human cells.
modalities.notes_zh: AstraZeneca Vaxzevria、康希诺 Convidecia 为代表。
modalities.notes_en: AstraZeneca Vaxzevria and CanSino Convidecia are representative.

modalities.description_zh: 用灭活（杀死）的整病原体诱导免疫，是最传统的疫苗工艺之一。
modalities.description_en: Uses whole, inactivated (killed) pathogen to elicit immunity — one of the most traditional vaccine platforms.
modalities.notes_zh: Sinovac CoronaVac、Sinopharm BBIBP-CorV 为代表。
modalities.notes_en: Sinovac CoronaVac and Sinopharm BBIBP-CorV are representative.

modalities.description_zh: 提取患者（自体）T 细胞，转入嵌合抗原受体后回输，使其识别并杀伤肿瘤。多为个体化、一次性给药。
modalities.description_en: Patient (autologous) T cells engineered with a chimeric antigen receptor and reinfused to recognize and kill tumor cells. Typically personalized, single-dose.
modalities.notes_zh: 传奇生物/强生 Carvykti (cilta-cel, BCMA) 是中国出海里程碑。
modalities.notes_en: Legend Biotech/J&J Carvykti (cilta-cel, BCMA) is a Chinese go-global milestone.

modalities.description_zh: 用间充质基质/干细胞（MSC）作为活细胞药物，多为异体来源、调节免疫与炎症，用于移植物抗宿主病(GvHD)等。
modalities.description_en: Living-cell therapy using mesenchymal stromal/stem cells (often allogeneic) to modulate immunity and inflammation — e.g. for graft-versus-host disease.
modalities.notes_zh: Mesoblast Ryoncil (remestemcel-L) 为首个 FDA 获批的 MSC 疗法。
modalities.notes_en: Mesoblast's Ryoncil (remestemcel-L) is the first FDA-approved MSC therapy.

modalities.description_zh: 改造 T 细胞表达识别 HLA 呈递抗原的 T 细胞受体，可靶向胞内抗原，拓展实体瘤应用。
modalities.description_en: T cells engineered with a T-cell receptor recognizing HLA-presented antigens, enabling intracellular-antigen targeting and broader solid-tumor reach.
modalities.notes_zh: Adaptimmune Tecelra (afami-cel) 为首个获批 TCR-T。
modalities.notes_en: Adaptimmune Tecelra (afami-cel) was the first approved TCR-T.

modalities.description_zh: 用腺相关病毒(AAV)载体将功能基因递送至体内细胞，多为针对单基因遗传病的一次性根治型疗法。
modalities.description_en: Uses adeno-associated virus (AAV) vectors to deliver a functional gene in vivo — often one-time, potentially curative therapies for monogenic diseases.
modalities.notes_zh: Novartis Zolgensma、Roche/Spark Luxturna 为代表（定价极高）。
modalities.notes_en: Novartis Zolgensma and Roche/Spark Luxturna are representative (very high priced).

modalities.description_zh: 小干扰 RNA 通过 RNAi 机制沉默致病基因 mRNA，常用 GalNAc 偶联实现肝靶向长效给药。
modalities.description_en: Small interfering RNA silences disease-causing mRNA via RNAi; often GalNAc-conjugated for long-acting liver targeting.
modalities.notes_zh: Alnylam/Novartis Leqvio (inclisiran) 为代表。
modalities.notes_en: Alnylam/Novartis Leqvio (inclisiran) is representative.

modalities.description_zh: 单链反义寡核苷酸与靶 mRNA 互补结合，调控其剪接或降解，用于罕见神经肌肉病等。
modalities.description_en: Single-stranded antisense oligonucleotides bind complementary target mRNA to modulate splicing or trigger degradation; used in rare neuromuscular disease.
modalities.notes_zh: Biogen/Ionis Spinraza (nusinersen) 为代表。
modalities.notes_en: Biogen/Ionis Spinraza (nusinersen) is representative.

modalities.description_zh: 将靶向配体与放射性核素偶联，将辐射精准递送至表达靶点的肿瘤细胞（theranostics 诊疗一体）。
modalities.description_en: Couples a targeting ligand to a radioisotope to deliver radiation precisely to target-expressing tumor cells (theranostics).
modalities.notes_zh: Novartis Pluvicto (PSMA)、Lutathera 为代表；澳洲 Telix 专注此领域。
modalities.notes_en: Novartis Pluvicto (PSMA) and Lutathera are representative; Australia's Telix specializes here.

modalities.description_zh: 对已获批参照生物药高度相似、无临床意义差异的后续生物药，在原研专利到期后提供低价替代。
modalities.description_en: A follow-on biologic highly similar to an approved reference biologic with no clinically meaningful differences; provides lower-cost alternatives after originator patent expiry.
modalities.notes_zh: Celltrion、Samsung Bioepis、山德士(Sandoz) 为主力。
modalities.notes_en: Celltrion, Samsung Bioepis and Sandoz are leaders.

modalities.description_zh: 基于中医理论的多组分口服制剂（颗粒、胶囊、丸剂），在中国市场占重要份额。
modalities.description_en: Multi-component oral preparations (granules, capsules, pills) based on traditional Chinese medicine theory; a major share of the China market.
modalities.notes_zh: 同仁堂、云南白药、步长等为代表。
modalities.notes_en: Tong Ren Tang, Yunnan Baiyao and Buchang are representative.

sources.title: NMPA — China National Medical Products Administration

modalities.description_zh: 从中药材提取、经注射给药的制剂，在中国临床使用广泛但安全性与循证争议较多。
modalities.description_en: Injectable preparations extracted from Chinese medicinal materials; widely used clinically in China but subject to safety/evidence debate.
modalities.notes_zh: 天士力丹参类注射剂等为代表。
modalities.notes_en: Tasly's danshen-based injections are representative.

sources.title: NMPA — China National Medical Products Administration
